selfReview.method: Read all Japanese explanatory paragraphs, metadata and questions directly. Wrote full connected Khmer and reviewed source-to-target meaning and continuous prose for conditions, negation, recipients, terminology and clinical limits. Compared established own terminology only, checked identical Japanese paragraph consistency across own weeks01–10, then validated exact IDs/revisions/order/arrays/indices and all7absent reading fields after final correction.
semanticChecks: Blood pressure arterial-wall pressure; systoliccontraction/diastolicexpansion between beats, max/min two values within one heartbeat preserved. Values recorded together, not names of hypertension/hypotension diseases, no new diagnostic thresholds. Daily change, posture/activity/mentalstate/disease/time/premeasurement activity and both measurement contexts retained.

Excitement/tension/poor sleep/acute exercise/temperature change, straining and suppressing urine/stool urges retained. No toileting suppression for staff convenience. Postactivity difference reported with both values/conditions; abnormal value not ignored nor disease onset/cure inferred from one result. Contact/recheck follow individual plan/facility procedure.

Persistent high BP burden and possible absence of headache/selfrecognized symptoms require actual measurement and explicit medical-professional assessment. Lifestyle/genetic and secondary kidney disease possibilities retained. Hypertension burdening heart does not mean every heart disease causes hypertension. No guessed cause or independent stopping/increasing/decreasing medication; report measurements/baseline changes/personwords per treatment/support plan.

Brain infarctionvesselblocked versus hemorrhagevesselruptured, intracerebral/subarachnoid bleeding, coronary bloodflow angina/infarction, arteriosclerosiswallchange not one BPvalue retained. Retina/brain/eyes/kidneys/vessels assessed together by explicit medical professionals; lack of one symptom does not establish otherorganssafe. Teaching disease names not careworkerdiagnosis.

Bodyhead/neck/trunk/upper/lowerlimbs, chest/abdomen, inner/outereye corners, forehead/chin, exteriorneck/throat, arm/wrist/finger/fingertip/palm/dorsalhand, ankle/toe/heel/sole/dorsalfoot, waist versus wholeback and synonymous buttock labels retained. Affected/comparative unaffectedside not fixed left/right or guarantee no problem. Laterality personbased, site/time/personwords versus unasked intensity/cause; urgentreport not delayed until all questions done.

CNSbrain/spinalcord versus peripheral information links retained. Cranial12pairs/spinal31pairs explicitly pairs, not12or31individualnerves. Sensoryinformationbodytocenter versus motorcommandscentertobody, spinal bidirectional/reflex role preserved. Diagram anatomical site labels not same as one nervepair name; symptoms not selfdiagnosed from diagram.

Cerebrumunderstanding/consciousactivities and cerebellumcoordination/balance distinguished. Midbrain/pons/medulla compose brainstem regulating heartbeat/breathing/swallowing; ponsclassification not mere location memory. Diencephalon thalamus/hypothalamus autonomous/temp/sleep functions separate from cerebellum/brainstem; networkfunction not one emotion/action determined by one site. Illustrations not lesiondiagnosis steps.

Autonomic involuntaryvisceral adjustment, sympatheticactivity/tension and parasympatheticrest/recovery trends retained. Heartfaster/slower directions are trends, not measured personpulse. Manyperipheralvessels sympathetic tension/constriction and BPmultiplefactors retained; no universal perfectlyopposite action in everyorgan. Anxiety/personstate separate from unmeasuredBPrise, actual measuredvaluesconditions only.

Pupildilation/constriction is model of lightentry, not instruction neurologicalexam. GIinhibition/promotion not exhaustive eating/stool explanation; bronchidilation/constriction not breathlessnessdiagnosis/drugselection. Sympatheticeccrinesweat role retained, no directparasympatheticsweatstop symmetry. Organ/model limits and observationversuscause inference explicit, consultprofessionals when needed.
